keySentence: Toad loved fast cars more than he could control.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Toad bought the fastest car. He drove too fast. His friends were very worried. Toad loved fast cars more than he could control.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Toad went out and bought the fastest car he could find. He drove it through the countryside at amazing speed. Trees and houses flew past in a blur. Toad loved fast cars more than he could control or stop. Other animals had to jump out of the way when he passed. Rat shook his head sadly, knowing trouble was coming.
